title: Such a good deal!
text: the face cleanser alone was an 18 dollar value so everything in the box from there was a bonus! I have been wanting to get a beauty subscription box for the longest time but i only find really expensive ones. I love how this one has a little bit of everything. I wouldn't of bought the oil on my own and i loved trying it. It does feel a little weird but I don't normally wear lip glosses so its nice to try. It smells really good and it has a nice tint to it. The face wash i used this morning and it looks really weird from the charcoal. Hopefully in a few days i will give an update on results from using it. I also used the face cream today before priming my face for make up and it stays a little tacky after applying it. I cant wait for next month! I gave an overall rating of 4 stars because i would of loved to see some more full size products, and not as many face masks. But it is a great deal!
label: positive
